controls.detail: Rational interval checks of the Lipschitz kernel envelope; the universal integral O(1/N) bound is proved in TeX

controls.name: single-node negative control
controls.detail: Every N=1 vector is constant; finite positive gap is claimed only for N>=2

controls.name: regular spectral sectors
controls.detail: Exact constant-block eigenvalues; infinite zero-mean complement and resolvent proof are in the manuscript

controls.name: corner negative control
controls.detail: At u=1/2 the opposite radial directional derivatives are not negatives of each other; no Frechet derivative

controls.name: sharp readout perturbation
controls.detail: Finite compact model attains 2eta in R; normalized protection obeys the same-unit r0 bound

controls.name: setwise versus pointwise negative control
controls.detail: Setwise Hausdorff deformation zero and infinite sector resistance coexist with positive readout loss

controls.name: finite and zero cost sectors
controls.detail: Finite positive Hausdorff deformation with finite/zero cost gives finite/zero resistance, not a null-readout conclusion

controls.name: ablation versus recertification
controls.detail: A damaged stored certificate does not exclude another valid certificate on the same support

controls.name: non-admissible packet
controls.detail: Integrity gate suppresses action/support independently of the inferential score

controls.name: threshold controls
controls.detail: Strict signed margins survive bounded error; a flat zero score leaves the entire patch unresolved

controls.name: no finite collapse from a limit
controls.detail: A vanishing sequence of positive margins is not exact finite-stage collapse

controls.name: legibility packing control
controls.detail: Three unit-separated classes cannot have uniform distortion below 1/2 with two codes, for every tested encoder and decoded pair

controls.name: unnormalized metric negative control
controls.detail: Summable 2^-n weights with 4^n-scaled coordinate distances have growing weighted diameters; normalized tails vanish instead

controls.name: compact versus noncompact existence
controls.detail: Each finite inclusion tower S_n=[n,infinity) has a compatible point; witnesses escape and every tested fixed value is excluded later. Universal empty-intersection proof is in TeX.

controls.name: single-cut channel negative control
controls.detail: One faithful observed cut cannot distinguish all later histories

controls.name: noncommuting channel negative control
controls.detail: Identity C0 and first-bit-flipping C1 fail q0 C1=C0 pi0 on every binary two-stage history; the image is not coherent

controls.name: robust finite readout budget
controls.detail: Ternary all-zero/all-one histories, actual finite-cut tail and adverse measurement errors preserve the explicit pair and anchored-null residuals

controls.name: noise boundary negative control
controls.detail: Without a strict residual budget, a separation result alone cannot exclude both accepted null balls

controls.name: current null-theorem metadata
controls.detail: Historical demotions are preserved as provenance, not current conjecture status

controls.name: seven explicit certificate proofs
controls.detail: Each targeted proposition has an immediate source proof with its quantified scope

controls.name: audit provenance preserved
